title: Kimberly made Barcelona unforgettable !!

Her incredible knowledge of Barcelona’s history and culture made every experience more informative and memorable. title: 2 days in Barcelona

title: All the stars! excellent!!
text: My family spent two days with Kimberly at the end of May touring Barcelona and I cannot say enough wonderful things about our experience. She was wonderful to work with leading up to our trip and we got to see so much of Barcelona and Catalan culture in just two short days. Kimberly was the perfect guide for our family and was excellent with our three girls ages 5,7,10. We were not stuck to a strict schedule and had plenty of time to explore and take in the experience. My girls only wish we had more time with her!
author: Guide771793

title: See Barcelona with a local friend!
text: Our first trip to Barcelona did not disappoint!  Our family (4 adults) had a fantastic time exploring the city with Kimberly SigaMiga Barcelona.  The itinerary was personalized to our needs. We spent the first day touring the different neighborhoods in the city.  We got to try local foods and hear the history behind the traditions.   Our second day was spent walking by several Gaudí homes and Park Guéll and ended at Sagrada Familia. Kimberly made our first visit to Spain memorable.  She was also very helpful answering questions and recommended other excursions for us. We highly recommend her!
author: 987sandiab

title: SigaMiga Barcelona!
text: We had a wonderful week with Kimberly in Barcelona!  She is very organized and made sure we saw all the sites and cultural events.  She knows all the local people and that made our trip more enjoyable.  I highly recommend Komberly for your Barcelona experience!
author: juliagL8531DV

title: Excellent family tour.
text:
We had a wonderful time exploring Barcelona with Kimberly from Sigamiga. My husband and I and our 7/9 year olds started the day by meeting Kimberly for churros con chocolate where we were able to get to know each other and get energy for a long day of walking (8 hours). She took us through Born, Gothic, Raval and Barconleta, stopping to point out all historical, and cultural sites along the way. She explained and showed us the history of the city through old ruins. 
She kept it engaging for our children and allowed for plenty of rests especially to get yummy treats.  It was a great way to see
